seo.description: Careers from Curvature Body Sculpting.

content.title: Careers in body sculpting and wellness
content.text: Roles and compensation below were restored from the earlier website and need confirmation before recruitment opens.

content.title: Body Sculpting Technician
content.text:
Perform non-invasive body contouring treatments using advanced equipment. Provide consultations and develop treatment plans for clients.

Full-time · Indianapolis, IN

$35,000 - $50,000 + Commission

Requirements: Esthetician license or certification (or enrolled in program); Strong customer service skills; Ability to learn new technologies; Professional appearance and demeanor

Benefits listed previously: Paid training on all equipment; Commission on services and product sales; Health insurance after 90 days; Flexible scheduling; Career advancement opportunities

content.title: Licensed Esthetician
content.text:
Provide skincare treatments, facials, and skin analysis. Recommend products and home care routines for clients.

Full-time · Indianapolis, IN

$32,000 - $45,000 + Commission

Requirements: Valid Indiana Esthetician License; Experience with facial treatments; Knowledge of skincare products; Excellent communication skills

Benefits listed previously: Competitive base pay + commission; Product discounts; Continuing education support; Flexible scheduling

content.title: Wellness Consultant
content.text:
Help clients select wellness products, provide product education, and support the retail operations of our wellness shop.

Part-time · Indianapolis, IN

$15 - $20/hour + Commission

Requirements: Passion for wellness and self-care; Retail or customer service experience; Knowledge of aromatherapy and wellness products a plus; Friendly and approachable personality

Benefits listed previously: Flexible hours; Product discounts; Commission on sales; Path to full-time

content.title: Esthetician Apprentice
content.text:
Learn body sculpting and esthetics while earning. Perfect for Elevate for Humanity program graduates or current students.

Full-time · Indianapolis, IN

$14 - $16/hour during training

Requirements: Enrolled in or completed esthetician program; Eager to learn; Reliable and punctual; Professional attitude

Benefits listed previously: Paid on-the-job training; Path to technician role; Mentorship from experienced staff; Tuition assistance available
